notes: Self-declared subway-surfer type with automatic forward running and three fixed lanes, so Infinite Runner on lane-snap; the course terminating at Andy rather than running forever does not contradict the genre, since the player never controls their own speed and never chooses discrete jumps, so it is a lane runner with a finish rather than Racing or Obby. Kept Lane Runner for the shape, moving traffic and ground pickups but dropped chunk-modular, because the answers fix the street at about 500 studs for a single roughly 30-second authored run, so there is no long chunk queue to keep from drifting. Added obstacle-jump for the trash, powerup-buffs for the treats, marker-distance for the distance score, and hazard-kill for the traffic that ultimately ends the run — noting the run survives two trips and only ends on the third, when animal control takes him. Without a user I decided the duck-under obstacles ride along with the hurdle row since no option covers overhead barriers, that Andy is npc-population as the named figure at the end and marks where the run pays off, that the blocking Karens are static lane obstacles rather than ambient population, and that settlement-density carries the suburban street the whole track runs through.
